name: Datavant
desc:
Health Information Specialist 1 | $15.68 - $19.15/hr | Data Entry/Admin, No Sales Expectations
Company: Datavant
Industry: Healthcare Data / Health Information Management
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 You'd be processing requests for medical records, making sure the right people, patients, insurance companies, attorneys, get accurate information while keeping everything HIPAA compliant. That means answering calls about record status, preparing and organizing patient charts, and digitizing paperwork into the electronic health record system. You'd juggle two computer monitors while documenting everything across multiple platforms, and you might also help with faxes, mail, or the occasional walk-in. It's high-volume, detail-focused work where accuracy and confidentiality matter every single time.
Assessment Expected:
 Expect a basic assessment, a typing test, and a home internet speed test, since the posting doesn't state otherwise.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED
Required Experience: None strictly required
Preferred Experience: Healthcare environment experience, previous production or metric-based work, in-person customer service experience
Required Skills:
Basic computer proficiency, with Microsoft Word and Excel
Comfort using phones, fax machines, printers, and general office equipment
Professional verbal and written communication
Strong data entry skills
Ability to work with minimal supervision and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
Best Fit
 This role is ideal for:
A true entry level candidate, since only a high school diploma or GED is required
Someone detail oriented who takes confidentiality and HIPAA compliance seriously
Someone comfortable in a high-volume, production-paced environment
Someone who can multitask across two monitors and several software platforms at once
Not a Good Fit for
Anyone who cannot occasionally commute between locations or assist with in-person walk-ins, if applicable to their assigned site
Anyone unable to work overtime during peak seasons when required
Anyone who cannot meet post-offer health screening or vaccination requirements some client sites may require
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Release of information (ROI)
Medical records processing
HIPAA compliance
Patient chart preparation
Health information management
Data entry
Microsoft Word and Excel
Confidentiality
Customer service
Electronic health records (EHR)
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
Application
Expect an assessment at the end of the application or directly emailed to you
If the assessment is passing, expect a recruiter to reach out via email or text for a phone screen
If the phone screen passes, expect a final interview
Total time to hire from date of application can be anywhere from 3 to 15 days on average.
4-5 interview questions for this role:
Tell us about your experience handling confidential or sensitive information.
How do you stay accurate and organized when managing a high volume of requests?
Walk us through how you'd handle a call from a patient asking about the status of their medical records.
What's your comfort level working across multiple computer monitors and software platforms at once?
How do you handle changing priorities in a fast-paced work environment?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
Pay: $15.68 to $19.15 per hour, based on a comparable Datavant posting for this exact title. Not listed in the original posting
Shift: Full-time, Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM EST (converted to 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM CST)
Benefits: PTO, health, vision, and dental insurance, 401k savings plan, and tuition assistance
Equipment Provided: Yes, company equipment is provided, including computer, monitor, and virtual phone
Felony Friendly?: Due to the nature of this role, it will most likely be non-felony friendly
Drug Test: Not stated
Notes: This is a genuine entry level opportunity with only a high school diploma or GED required, and the company provides real onboarding support with a training program and assigned mentor. 
Career Pathway: Health Information Specialist 1 → Health Information Specialist 2 → Health Information Management Coordinator or Team Lead
